name: OrbitalIonCannon-SE
title: Orbital Ion Cannon (Space Exploration Edition)
author: qwuiiin
description:
Launch orbital ion cannons with your rocket silo and call down the thunder on enemy nests. Cannons stay in orbit of the planet they were launched from, so every planet or moon builds its own arsenal. Works with Space Exploration zones and Space Age planets.
Based on Supercheese's original Orbital Ion Cannon (MIT).
